title: Syrian Kabanos Skewers with Yummy Sauce
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make dish that combines the smoky taste of kabanos with a tangy and sweet sauce, all on a skewer. Great for a quick lunch or dinner.

ingredients.name: yummy sauce
ingredients.notes: see below for yummy sauce ingredients

instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together yummy sauce ingredients (see below).
Soak the skewers in water for at least 30 minutes.
Thread onion, garlic, and kabanos onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Brush skewers with yummy sauce and season with paprika and black pepper.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until kabanos is slightly charred.
Serve hot with additional yummy sauce on the side, if desired.
